current_bootshim.source: inherited from upstream Selene/Luna BootShim packaging

observed_fixed_reserved_evidence.note: No supplied CP2A DTBO fixed override covers 0x5fc41000..0x5ff00000. The 2023 base DTS also has no fixed reserved-memory node there. Absence of a node is not proof that boot firmware leaves the region free.

required_next_evidence: Matching CP2A vendor_kernel_boot.img: the supplied CP2A vendor_boot.img has dtb_size=0, and boot.img contains only a 72-byte empty FDT.
Pre-Linux bootloader/firmware memory ownership or equivalent evidence for 0x5fc41000..0x5ff00000.
Recovery path review before any hardware boot experiment.
